Physical examination reveals some numbness in his hands and thighs, as well as diffuse spine tenderness. MRI of scans of his entire spine show increased tumor burden in his lumbar and cervical spine causing multiple areas of severe stenosis. You are also able to identify new lesions seeding his peritoneum.
Question: Would you offer morphine to Ho? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
